title: We automate the routine. Decisions stay with you.
text: No “AI for the sake of AI”. First we figure out how the process really works in your company, then we hand one specific, easy-to-check job to the machine.

steps.title: Map the process.
steps.text: How a lead or an order moves through your business today: who does what, where time gets lost.

steps.title: Write down the rules.
steps.text: What to count, where to pass it, what counts as an error. Without this, automation only speeds up the mess.

steps.title: Automate one function.
steps.text: Not “a robot instead of a manager”, but one specific routine with a clear result.

steps.title: Measure the effect.
steps.text: How many hours and errors went away. No effect — we change the approach.

examples: Website leads go straight to Telegram and your CRM
One price list updates the website and marketplaces
A weekly sales report builds itself
A bot takes orders and books clients
principle: AI is a tool inside the process. People set the rules and make the decisions.
